about: Case footprints for the layout planner (getting-started/layout.md). w x h in grid cells as the case sits unturned; `blocks` (optional) are cells a case overhangs, so nothing else can go there; no case in the list has one now. A board whose case is not designed yet has `zip` null and says so in `nocase`. tools/test_generators.mjs checks every other footprint against the Grid column of getting-started/cases.md.
